Class StripeService.JobBuilder

public class StripeService.JobBuilder

Builder pattern class for configuring and initiating Stripe charge synchronization from the Stripe API. Supports filtering by date range or payment intent ID, pagination via startingAfter, and configurable job scheduling delays. Provides a fluent interface for configuration and enqueues SyncStripeCharges queueable jobs when ready.

Since:
